import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
record = Path(sys.argv[1])
cgroup = Path("/proc/self/cgroup")
(record / "probe-start.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "pid": os.getpid(),
    "parent_pid": os.getppid(),
    "cgroup": cgroup.read_text() if cgroup.exists() else None,
}))
time.sleep(5)
(record / "payload-survived.txt").write_text("finished after submitting launcher exited\n")
print("CPU payload completed")
